summary: [standards] F5 names the conformance cases that expect a schema answer. The expectations were regenerated (the diff is the 1.4 form and contractVersion only, checked), but the case description in atip-1-1-schema-documents/case.yaml still says '(0.34 L1) ... kind tree, level L1 ... a command path answers the command document with typed options, errors, outputs, input and the schemas its refs name': the tree says L2 and the command document names its schemas but does not hold them. Update it to the 1.4 form (level L2, call surface, schemas under --schemas). No case runs 'schema <command> --schemas --json'; adding one step (and its expected output) is cheap and puts the new answer under the conformance corpus (note, not required by the brief).
